label: Custom Votes
description: Adds extra /cv vote types (ruleset, excessive weapons, force-connect) and admin commands.

commands.name: listcv
commands.description: Lists the available custom vote types.

commands.name: forceconnect
commands.description: Forces a connected player to reconnect to a different local server port.

commands.name: forceconnect_all
commands.description: Forces all connected players to reconnect to a different local server port.

cvars.label: Disable Player-Removal Votes
cvars.description: Blocks /cv votes that would kick/remove a player.

cvars.label: Disable Cvar Votes
cvars.description: Blocks /cv votes that change server cvars.

cvars.label: Disable Reboot Vote
cvars.description: Blocks the /cv vote type that restarts the server.

cvars.label: Cvar-Vote Call Permission
cvars.description: Minimum permission level required to call a cvar-changing /cv vote.
